hotspots.title: 大规模算力上线：不只是缺电
hotspots.fact: Elon Musk认为，把算力上线的困难简化为“缺电”并不准确：在极短时间内大规模上线计算能力，各个环节都很难；如果可用时间翻倍，问题会相对容易，但现实没有这么多时间。
hotspots.whyItMatters: GPU出货不等于客户已形成可用算力。电力、机房、网络和交付速度共同限制部署，可能使芯片订单兑现与客户收入兑现出现时间差。
hotspots.caveat: 这是对部署约束的个人观点，不是NVIDIA订单或交付指引。
hotspots.author: @elonmusk
hotspots.eventTimeNote: 未知；讨论持续的算力部署约束
hotspots.originalText: “Lack of electricity” is an oversimplification. Everything is hard about bringing massive compute online at extremely high speed. If there was twice as much time, this would be relatively easy, but there is not.

hotspots.title: 自定义AI芯片竞争，关键可能转向网络和光学
hotspots.fact: Convequity认为，网络而非计算正决定自定义AI芯片的竞争优势。作者主张Broadcom可通过高速SerDes、网络能力和光学供应配套降低客户系统总成本，并预计其将从NVIDIA取得更多份额。
hotspots.whyItMatters: 若系统瓶颈从计算转向互联，价值可能向网络与光学配套迁移；需比较实际部署成本和客户采用，而不只比较芯片设计费用。
hotspots.caveat: 竞争份额、224G能力与光学短缺判断为研究账号观点，未独立核验；不能据此确认其他厂商不具备相关能力。
hotspots.author: @convequity
hotspots.eventTimeNote: 未知；这是产业竞争观点
hotspots.originalText: Networking, not compute, now decides custom AI chip wins, and in our view that is Broadcom's ($AVGO) edge. As GPUs become more like specialized AI processors, matrix compute looks much the same everywhere. At 224G high-speed chip connections (SerDes), only Nvidia ($NVDA) and Broadcom can do it. If you want a custom chip, you go to Broadcom. That is why we avoid Marvell ($MRVL). A cheaper design partner is not necessarily cheaper overall: weaker connections and networking compound costs after deployment, resulting in higher total system costs. The bottleneck is moving from the switch to the optics. Lasers and optical signal-processing chips are short, and Broadcom can bundle priority optical supply with its custom chips, even for customers running Nvidia GPUs. Nvidia's lack of optical know-how is becoming its biggest disadvantage, and we expect Broadcom to take more share from it for years to come.

hotspots.title: High-NA采用时点：成本与量产成熟度的取舍
hotspots.fact: 该账号转述TSMC在10月15日电话会的说法：计划2030年开始使用High-NA EUV，采用新设备不仅要技术先进，也要成本合理且适合量产；另提及与ASML合作12英寸光罩、目标2031年。

hotspots.caveat: 电话会内容为第三方转述，未独立核验；2030/2031为计划而非已兑现结果，本条是当日讨论旧事件。

hotspots.eventTimeNote: 作者转述10月15日电话会，具体时刻未知
hotspots.originalText: TSMC plans to start using High-NA EUV in 2030, when it expects the technology to be mature, C.C. Wei said on the company’s Oct. 15 earnings call. Asked whether adopting it later than rivals would put TSMC at a disadvantage, Wei said new tools must offer advanced technology at a reasonable cost and be mature enough for mass production. TSMC is also working with ASML on 12-inch photomasks, targeting 2031. Wei expects High-NA to be cost-effective enough for mass production at that point.
